secrets.name: AI_INTEGRATIONS_GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Gemini API key used to generate and improve prompts. Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey (or supply the key for your own Gemini-compatible proxy together with AI_INTEGRATIONS_GEMINI_BASE_URL).

secrets.name: AI_INTEGRATIONS_OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key, only needed when a GPT/o-series model is picked on the Settings page. Get one at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys.
